note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Haves, have-nots and know-nots: Inside AI's new class divide
items.blurb: As Fable, Sol and Mythos ship under access gates, Axios argues a widening gap between AI's users, non-users and skeptics.

items.title: OpenAI power consolidates under co-founder Greg Brockman ahead of prospective IPO
items.blurb: With Fidji Simo departing, product authority concentrates under President Greg Brockman as OpenAI positions for a possible public offering.

items.title: OpenAI's Fidji Simo steps down over health issues
items.blurb: OpenAI's applications chief exits to manage a chronic illness (POTS), moving to a part-time advisor role after an April medical leave.

items.title: Inside the alternative playbook to AI regulation
items.blurb: As Washington leans on export threats and pre-release reviews, states and industry test a lighter-touch regulatory model.

items.title: Apple sues OpenAI alleging trade secret theft, says scheme was 'at every level'
items.blurb: Apple's suit names OpenAI's hardware chief over alleged trade-secret theft; Apple confirms its new Siri will run on Google Gemini, not ChatGPT.

items.title: SK Hynix rises 13% in Nasdaq debut. Chairman tells CNBC 'demand is enormous'
items.blurb: The HBM-memory maker closed +13% in a record $26.5B ADR listing; chairman says AI-driven memory demand shows no sign of shrinking.

items.title: The AI race is shifting from bigger models to cheaper, smarter systems
items.blurb: As frontier gains narrow, buyers route work to the cheapest 'good-enough' model, pushing labs toward efficiency over raw scale.

items.title: Meta updates its Spark model, releases developer version
items.blurb: Meta ships Muse Spark 1.1 and starts charging on a paid API ($1.25/$4.25 per M), its first move into selling AI access.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.6 and ChatGPT Work tool
items.blurb: GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) goes broadly public after the government hold lifts; new ChatGPT Work assembles docs across connected apps.

items.title: Transcript: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman speaks with CNBC's Julia Boorstin
items.blurb: Altman says GPT-5.6 Sol is 54% more token-efficient on agentic coding and details the government back-and-forth over the rollout.

items.title: Behind the Curtain: Three big AI trends are colliding at once
items.blurb: Axios frames three converging forces: revived US frontier models, cheaper Chinese open models, and an intensifying US-China capability race.

items.title: AI 'scientists' promise to accelerate research — how do they work?
items.blurb: Google DeepMind and FutureHouse unveil multi-agent systems that generate hypotheses, propose experiments and refine on results.

items.title: OpenAI's newest model is 54% more token-efficient on agentic coding, Altman tells CNBC
items.blurb: OpenAI touts GPT-5.6 Sol's efficiency and coding gains as cheaper inference reshapes the economics of frontier deployment.

items.title: New warning calls for slowing the race to superintelligence
items.blurb: A fresh report urges labs to ease off the superintelligence sprint as capability outpaces oversight.

items.title: Meta to put its 'Iris' AI chip into production in September
items.blurb: Meta's in-house MTIA accelerator enters production as it moves to roughly double compute toward 14 gigawatts next year.

items.title: OpenAI CEO: Chinese open-source models are getting very good
items.blurb: Altman acknowledges narrowing gap as open-weight labs like DeepSeek, Moonshot and Meituan push near the closed frontier.

items.title: These 10 states are best positioned to land AI data center deals despite rising public opposition
items.blurb: Ranks states by power supply and site-readiness for data centers as local backlash blocks projects and strains grids.

items.title: Teams of AI agents boost speed of research
items.blurb: Multi-agent systems from DeepMind and FutureHouse generate and test hypotheses, accelerating drug-discovery workflows.

items.title: Agents AMIE and MIRA advance medical AI capabilities
items.blurb: Autonomous clinical agents matched or beat physicians on diagnosis and management in simulations; not yet deployable.

items.title: OpenAI exec Fidji Simo says she's stepping down due to chronic illness, will transition to advisor
items.blurb: Simo, hired from Instacart in 2025 to run OpenAI's consumer business, cites a severe flare of a chronic condition and shifts to advising.

items.title: Palo Alto CEO Arora says AI pricing needs to fall 90% as token costs skyrocket
items.blurb: Nikesh Arora argues per-token costs must drop up to 90% for large-scale enterprise AI adoption to pencil out.

items.title: OpenAI gets U.S. regulatory approval for GPT-5.6 rollout: Axios report
items.blurb: Commerce Department cleared OpenAI to broadly release GPT-5.6 after security testing, ending a government-requested rollout limit.

items.title: Scoop: Trump administration lifts restrictions on OpenAI's GPT-5.6
items.blurb: Government lifts its hold on GPT-5.6's wide release after additional Commerce Department testing and company meetings.

items.title: OpenAI to publicly release GPT-5.6 AI models, ending government-requested limits
items.blurb: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna go public Thursday, two weeks after a government-requested limit to trusted partners.
